chunks: As for those who deny, it is all the same if you warn them or not, they will not believe.

key_terms.سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ: It is all the same to them

ai.seo_question: Why do some people not believe even when warned by the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *khutmah* (divine seal) upon the hearts of those who persistently reject truth, distinguishing between mere unbelief and the finality of it. It underscores that the Prophet’s warning is a means to an end, but for the stubborn, the message fails to penetrate due to their own spiritual obstinacy. This highlights the interplay between human free will in choosing disbelief and divine knowledge of that choice.
